confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Ha mazgabaanne a kaardiyata ubbaa hara ogiya sirssane?
delete-board-confirm-popup: Mazgabati, kaardiyaati, malaatatinne oosoti ubbay xayana, qassi bookkiyaa giddobaa simmisanaw ne danddayakka. Simmissanaw danddayettenna.
drag-to-reorder: Maaruwaa laammanawu goochcha. Pude kiyiyoogaanne duge wodhdhiyoogaa bessiya wonttafetu qulfeti issi tangguwaa qaassees.
enable-permanent-delete-description: Ubbaa alaafiyati shemppuwan xayettida yohota merinaa xayssana mala maata. Ha giigissuwaa oottissiyoogee ba huuphen aybanne xayssenna.
feature-approval-required: WeKan ooraxissuwaa baggaara gujjettiya oosota alaafiyaay dooyana gakkanaw gorddidaadan wotta
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu → Qaaxxay asi ubbay wurssetta gallassaa woykko saaminttaa kaameta bolli ay oottidaakko qassi ay wodee aadhdhidaakko bessees.
feature-preview-admins: Alaafiyati gorddida oosota be7oosona, koyro paaccana mala
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu → Wogati asay kushiyan zaaretti zaaretti oottiyoobaappe wogaa zorees.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ubbaa koyiyoogee "ta wodee aadhdhida kaardeta" giyaagaa mala qaalata akeekees.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu → Ne wurssetta xomoosaappe doomettidi harati bolli ay laammidaakko bessees.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Wodiyaa qoodaa qassi daro bookkiyatu wodiyaa qoodaa.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bookkiyaa haasayaa oosuwaa sohuwaadan: oosuwaa sohoti, bookkiyaa, ogiyaa, mazgabatanne kaardiyaa kanaaleta mittadan, kaardiyaa giddon qassi a qofati haasayaa kiitaadan.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Issi kaardiyaa sunttay de'iya daro kolomiya shiiquwan - wurssiyaaninne, kase oottanabaaninne, malaataaninne woy hara baan - gochchiyan kolomiyaa giddon sirssettees.
feature-views-email-desc: Bookkiyaa iimeeliyaa saaxinaadan: iimeeliyaa mazgabay gelliyaa saaxinaa, mazgabati kifiliyaa, malaatati malaatata, qassi yaraati bookkiyaa teesuwaappe iimeeliyaa xaafoosonne zaaroosona.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Attida oosuwaa guuttatuwaa, polettida oosuwaa darotuwaa, shiiqida oosuwaa hemettaa, doomettosappe polettees gakkanaw wodiyaa qassi oychchettosappe polettees gakkanaw wodiyaa, issi wodiyan polettida oosuwaa qoodaa, pollettibeenna oosuwaa aadhdhida wodiyaa, diggiyabata, Monte Carlo qassi hara oosuwaa hemettaa likkiyabata.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaardiyati de7ana kesettida misiliyaa bolla malaataadan.
feature-views-overview-desc: Qoodaa erissuwaa, oosoy imettida asaa baggaara shaakko, ogiyaa giigissuwaa, xeelluwaa bookkiya qassi gita bookkiya.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Medhdhiyo miishshaa attida oosotu mazgabaa, guutta ooso wodiyata, ooso wodiyaa erissuwaa qassi oosuwaa eesotettaa.
feature-views-table-desc: Bookkiya kaardiyatu shaahuwaa mala, marataa laammana danddayettiya.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bookkiyaa GitHub woy Gitea metuwaa kaalliyaagaadan: kaardiyaa metuwaadan, malaatatanne gita malaatata, qofata haasayaadan, gattidobata faayiletadan, qassi bookkiyaa taarikiyaa simmiyoogaara.
home-board-empty: Gelidoogaappe guyye dooyettana mala issi bookkiya xalaala hagaa goochcha
home-board-remove-confirm: Ha bookkiya Keettaappe diggane? Bookkiya huuphe xayettenna.
multi-selection-active: Bookkiyata dooranaw malaataa wottiyo saaxinetuwaa qoxxa
set-selected-home: Keettaa bookkiya oottada wotta (gelidoogaappe guyye dooyettees)
